name: StockPKG Films
old_description: Nationally stocked film substrates. Innovative laminations. Large U.S. inventory selection. Sustainable solutions. Educated sales professionals. Industry leading pricing. Dependable products.
about:
StockPKG Films, headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, was founded in 2008. The company began as a supplier of packaging films and has since expanded to offer custom lamination and precision slitting services from its own facilities.

The company produces and stocks a range of flexible packaging films including barrier, non-barrier, and metalized substrates, as well as proprietary pre-laminated Lightning Lam films featuring InkRite Technology for up to 99% ink adhesion. It also manufactures LidShield lidding films with options such as anti-fog, breathable perforations, and enhanced barrier constructions. In-house capabilities include precision slitting and rewinding to customer-specified widths, along with custom lamination. StockPKG operates a Make & Hold program that allows customers to lock in pricing and maintain inventory across multiple U.S. warehouses.

StockPKG serves printers and converters in the flexible packaging industry, with a focus on food packaging applications. Its clear BOPP films are stocked for common food packaging needs, while its Lightning Lam line addresses ink adhesion challenges in digital printing. Customers include businesses seeking quick lead times and consistent quality for both standard and custom film constructions.

The company differentiates itself through its InkRite Technology, which reduces ink consumption and improves print quality on laminated surfaces, and through its Make & Hold inventory strategy that helps mitigate raw-material price fluctuations. A team of sales representatives with decades of industry experience supports product selection and technical requirements.
